description: A two-act science show! In Act 1, Robo, Bunny and Frog make real shadows with a flashlight: block the light, move closer, move the light, and test a clear cup, wax paper and cardboard. In Act 2, a rubber band guitar hums and rice dances on a drum when sound makes it shake.

youtube.title: Light and Sound for Kids! Shadow Puppets and Dancing Rice | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
A two-act science show! In Act 1, Robo, Bunny and Frog make real shadows with a flashlight: block the light, move closer, move the light, and test a clear cup, wax paper and cardboard. In Act 2, a rubber band guitar hums and rice dances on a drum when sound makes it shake.
For first graders: light, shadows and vibrations. Try the experiments with a grown-up, never shine a flashlight in anyone's eyes, and keep rubber bands away from faces.

do.text: Welcome to the show! Look at the screen.
A shadow! Two long ears. Who is it?
It's me, Bunny!
Here's another one. A wagging tail!
Woof! It's me, Dog!
How do shadows happen? And how do sounds happen?
Two shows today! Act 1: Light!
Act 1: Light
Here is my flashlight. It shines light.
light
Light travels in straight lines.
Fun fact: light is so fast!
It could go around the Earth seven times in one second!
Bunny, please stand in the light.
Bunny blocks the light. Behind her, a dark shape forms.
block
That dark shape is a shadow!
shadow
Now, I turn the light off.
No light?
No shadow! Now the light is back on.
Can I try? Watch me jump away from my shadow!
Hey! My shadow sticks to my feet!
Ha ha! Your shadow goes where you go, Frog.
Shadow lab! Bunny, walk closer to the light.
Will the shadow get bigger or smaller?
Let's see!
Bigger! Closer to the light makes a big shadow.
bigger
Now walk close to the screen.
Smaller! Close to the screen makes a small shadow.
smaller
I'll move the light. Where will the shadow go?
The light went right, so the shadow moved left!
The shadow always goes the other way.
the other way
Thank you, Bunny! Now a see-through test.
Which one makes the darkest shadow?
A clear cup, wax paper, or cardboard?
First, the clear cup.
Light goes through! Almost no shadow.
light goes through
Next, wax paper.
Some light gets through. A faint shadow.
some light
Last, cardboard.
It blocks the light! A dark shadow.
blocks light
Cardboard makes the darkest shadow!
Block the light, a shadow grows!
Try shadows at home, with a grown-up.
with a grown-up
Never shine a flashlight in anyone's eyes.
Intermission! Next, Act 2: Sound!
Act 2: Sound
Welcome to my sound lab! This is a box guitar.
It's a box with rubber bands. Let's pluck one!
Look! The band shakes very fast. It hums!
hum
Shaking back and forth is called vibrating.
vibrate
Now I put my finger on it.
It stops shaking, and the sound stops!
A tight band sounds high.
high
A loose band sounds low.
low
Now you hum. Put a hand on your throat.
Hmmmm. Do you feel it buzz?
Fun fact: when you talk, your vocal folds shake!
Vocal folds are small parts inside your throat.
Hmmm! It tickles!
Now, dancing rice! This drum has rice on top.
I'll tap a pan nearby. Will the rice jump?
The rice jumped! The sound went through the air.
It made the drum skin shake, and the rice bounced!
Now a louder tap. Bigger jumps or smaller?
Bigger! A louder sound makes bigger jumps.
loud
A soft sound makes small jumps.
soft
Dog, can you help? One short woof!
Woof!
Even a woof made the rice wiggle!
Fun fact: space has no air to carry sound. Space is silent!
Shake, shake, hear it hum!
Try the sound lab at home, with a grown-up.
with a grown-up
Keep rubber bands away from faces. Rice stays on the drum!
Science quiz! Think, then say the answer.
Science Quiz
Question one. What makes a shadow?
Something blocking the light!
Question two. Bunny moves closer to the flashlight.
Does her shadow get bigger or smaller?
Bigger!
Question three. Which makes the darkest shadow?
A clear cup, wax paper or cardboard?
Cardboard!
Question four. What is the rubber band doing when it hums?
Shaking! It vibrates.
Last one. Why did the rice jump?
The sound made the drum skin shake!
Curtain call! Everyone, take a bow.
Look! Our shadows bow too.
Watch this! I'll step out of the light.
My shadow is gone! I did it!
No light, no shadow! Well done, Frog.
Block the light and you make a shadow.
Shake something and you make a sound!
Thank you for coming to our show! Bye-bye!
